name: MedChem Designer
tierReason: It focuses on molecular sketching and ADMET prediction, while public documentation does not establish ChemDraw-style publication document production.
summary: A molecular sketcher for designing compounds and predicting selected ADMET properties.

license.text: Proprietary; basic sketching and selected predictions are free, with additional functions requiring paid companion licenses.

price.text: Free; additional functions require paid companion licenses (2026-11-05).

caveats: Optical structure recognition requires a paid ADMET Predictor or MedChem Studio license.
Download is gated by a vendor registration form.
The full MedChem Designer manual is bundled with the ADMET Predictor installation.
